title: Battery range history
subtitle: BMS-based rated-range estimates from your recorded charging history.
qualification: This trend follows the battery management system's rated-range estimate. Changes do not establish physical battery degradation.
latestMedian: Latest month with usable range observations
baseline: First month with usable range observations
comparisonNeedsData: Requires two distinct months with usable range observations and at least 3 observations each.
changePercent: {value}% versus the first month with usable range observations
trendDescription: Monthly medians. Months without qualifying observations remain gaps; sparse months remain visible.
chartTitle: Monthly BMS rated-range estimates at 100% charge
chartDescription: Zero-based range axis in kilometres. Each point is one month's median; lines connect adjacent observed months only. Exact values and observation counts are in the table below.
empty: No qualifying range observations yet. After synchronization, completed charges with a recorded rated range, more than 5 kWh added and an ending charge level of 20–100% can contribute.
tableLabel: Monthly range medians and observation counts
coverageCounts: {used} of {total} completed charges qualify; {rejected} were excluded because rated range, charge level or added energy is missing or unsuitable. Open, future and invalid time spans are not counted.
formula: For each qualifying charge: TeslaMate's end rated range × 100 ÷ end state of charge. The monthly value is the median of these estimates, not a capacity measurement derived from energy or consumption.
filter: Only completed charges with more than 5 kWh added, an integer end charge level from 20 to 100% and a positive, finite recorded rated range qualify. Samples are grouped by charging completion in the app timezone. A comparison needs at least 3 observations in both the first and latest month with usable range observations.
baselineNote: The reference is your first month with usable range observations, not the vehicle when new. The archive may start earlier. Missing earlier range history cannot be reconstructed, and a first usable month with few observations is never replaced with a later baseline.
causes: Battery replacement, firmware changes, calibration and BMS estimation can affect this trend. It is not a battery health percentage or a diagnostic test.
